_note: HUD v2. Rects are [x, y, w, h] in pixels inside the Roblox safe area (ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset=false, ScreenInsets=CoreUISafeInsets). Three reference viewports; interpolate by anchoring (anchor field). 'reserved' rects are Roblox/other controls that HUD must not overlap. tools/validate.py checks overlap and coverage.

rules.coverageNote: maxCoverage counts persistent elements; transient elements (phase, toast, hint) may add at most maxTransientCoverage
rules.panels: ink (27,36,64) at 35% transparency, 10px corner, NO strokes; text paper (255,249,231)
rules.worldFirst: loop payouts, tech tags, wrap counts and NEW SPECIES appear in the 3D world at the loop centroid, never as HUD panels
rules.oneToast: at most one toast line visible; queue max 3, 1.6s each; never centre-screen
removedFromHud: save status (menu only; a small cloud icon appears only on save FAILURE)
album card panel (replaced by world-space NEW! tag + results recap)
event name label (replaced by phase text on change only)

elements.desc: m:ss, turns gold at 0:25, pulses 1/s in last 10s (no pulse in reduced motion)
phase name; visible 3s on change then fades to 0
capacity pips (filled = carried, species-coloured) + bank multiplier chip
multiplier label + draining bar; hidden at x1 with no active chain
icon button; badge dot when something is claimable
two charge diamonds with radial refill; key glyph shown for the first 3 rounds only
first-session coaching line (see 07); max 40 chars; never shown after round 3
84px round touch button; charge pips on its rim

results._note: Results is a bottom sheet, not a centred wall: the arena (and your parade lap) stays visible above it.

columns: BEST LOOP replay card: top-down mini drawing of your best loop with its tags (w 280)
NEXT GOAL + one CLAIM button + auto-next countdown (w 240)

menu._note: Existing Menu.luau tabs are kept (Play, Album, Upgrades, Goals, Style, Settings). Restyle only: full-height right drawer, desktop width 420, phone width 100%; never opens automatically during a round.
menu.albumCard: species card shows: silhouette, behaviour one-liner, the counterplay TIP (unlocked after first catch), signature stars, Gilded mark
